scope: Agent inspection of the replacement matched comparison sheets, all nine eye-pose rows and both portrait renders; not official scores or independent human naturalness ratings.

socket_integration.reason: Matched nine-pose crops show fitted lid margins and tear ducts with less visible separation around the eyes.

eye_appearance.reason: Softer iris/sclera transitions and restrained moist shading integrate the eyes better; the non-refractive synthetic appearance remains visible.

skin_response.reason: Shaped lighting and regional roughness/subsurface response give more facial volume than the flatter baseline; texture mottling remains a limitation.

grooming.reason: Tapered lashes replace heavy fan cards; front and three-quarter portraits show a coherent short swept-back groom. Brows remain texture-based and the hairline is stylized.

pupil_readability.reason: Pupils remain clearly readable across the nine matched poses and both portraits. Unchanged five-direction/reset and nine-anchor image/mask gates pass.

limitations: Stylized short groom and hairline; existing textured brows
